`musical_gap`:

Describe the exact track or repeated album failure this change addresses.

`control_or_baseline`:

Name the incumbent, naive control, previous accepted mechanism, or explicit
refusal boundary the change must beat.

`owner_audition_effect`:

Describe the new or improved listening decision the owner will receive. A method
call, provider execution, benchmark, or gate count is not an audition effect.

`private_execution_required`:

List the exact private source media, local bindings, model assets, credentials,
hardware, or owner review still required. Write `none` only when the full claim
was exercised without them.

## What changed

Explain the implementation and why it is the smallest type-correct change for the
declared gap.

## Evidence

Record the commands, tests, receipts, controls, and real-material execution used.
Separate software correctness, machine qualification, signal sanity, musical
acceptance, and rights.

## Authority boundary

Confirm that providers remain lower authority than the conductor, the renderer
does not invent decisions, human acceptance is not inferred, and private source
material is not committed.

## Failure mode

State how this change could still fail musically, operationally, or evidentially,
and what returned evidence would expose that failure.
